## Summary

Describe the externally observable change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, linting, type checks and tests pass.
- [ ] OpenAPI and SDKs remain synchronized when contracts changed.
- [ ] Migrations are forward-only and idempotent when storage changed.
- [ ] Security, privacy and license impact was reviewed.
- [ ] Benchmark claims are generated from committed runners and raw results.

## Rollout and rollback

State configuration changes, compatibility risks, monitoring signals and the rollback path.
